chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Sa'id al-Askari narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Ali b. al-Aswad al-Ijli narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Hamid b. Yahya Abu Yahya al-Himmani narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr al-Hudhali narrated to us from al-Zuhri from Ubaydullah b. Abdullah from Ibn Abbas. He said:
When the month of Ramadan would begin, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) would free every captive and give to every beggar.
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet Muhammad's practice regarding captives and charity during Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Ibn Abbas, describes the Prophet Muhammad's generous custom during Ramadan: he would release all captives and give charity to every person who asked. This reflects the spirit of mercy and generosity that defines the holy month, setting a prophetic example for all Muslims to increase their charitable giving during Ramadan.
